context: A mom negotiates nap time with her young son
purpose: Teach: いまや/おくれ/暖かく/例年/短時間/知り合っ/昼寝/甘え

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔ちゃん、そろそろ昼寝の時間だよ。お布団も暖かくしておいたからね。
lines.en: Sho, it's about time for your nap. I've already warmed up the futon for you.
lines.style: Warm coaxing maternal tone, slightly singsong and inviting

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やだー！ぼく、もう忍者だから寝ないもん！
lines.en: No way! I'm already a ninja, so I'm not sleeping!
lines.style: Energetic child protest, playful and defiant high pitch

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 忍者さんでも短時間だけ目を閉じて休むんだよ。ね？
lines.en: Even ninjas close their eyes for a short while to rest, you know? Okay?
lines.style: Patient negotiating mom voice, gentle persuasion with smile

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やー、こないだ公園で会ったお友達と遊ぶ約束したもん！
lines.en: Nooo, I promised to play with the friend I met at the park the other day!
lines.style: Whiny child bargaining, drawing out vowels stubbornly

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日は例年よりずっと暑いから、ちょっとおくれて行ってもお友達はまだ公園にいるよ。
lines.en: It's much hotter than usual years today, so even if we go a little late your friend will still be at the park.
lines.style: Reasoning calmly with child, soft maternal reassurance

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ほんと？じゃあママも一緒に寝てくれる？
lines.en: Really? Then will Mama sleep with me too?
lines.style: Suddenly soft and hopeful child voice, vulnerable

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: もう、甘えん坊さんだなあ。ママも翔ちゃんのパパと知り合ったころから、ぎゅーってして寝るのが大好きなんだよ。
lines.en: Oh, what a little spoiled one you are. You know, ever since I first met your papa, I've loved snuggling up to sleep too.
lines.style: Affectionate laughing mom, melting into tender voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: えへへ、ぼくいまや世界一しあわせな忍者だ！ママ大好き！
lines.en: Hehe, I'm now the happiest ninja in the world! I love you, Mama!
lines.style: Bright joyful child exclamation, full of happiness
